questions.q: Which colours does the Chelsea filter let through?
questions.why: All the rest of the spectrum is stopped.

questions.q: Which element makes a stone “turn red” under the filter?
questions.why: Cobalt also turns red; iron does not.

choices: the spinel turns red, the sapphire stays dark green

questions.q: How should you observe with the filter?
choices: Stone on white paper, strong tungsten light, filter close to the eye
questions.why: The darker the stone, the harder the reaction is to see.
